spec.prompt: Using the reference image, keep EXACTLY the same woman (same braids ponytail, mustard-yellow top, the same orange-blue-green wax-print skirt, sandals, same proportions). Draw an 8-frame walk cycle with her facing UP-RIGHT (back three-quarter view walking away from the camera, like cell 4 of the reference), one frame per cell in a single row, same size and same baseline in every cell. Frame poses in order: 1 right foot steps forward, left arm forward; 2 weight on right foot, body slightly lower; 3 left leg passing, body highest; 4 left foot reaching forward; 5 left foot steps forward, right arm forward; 6 weight on left foot, body slightly lower; 7 right leg passing; 8 right foot reaching forward.
